name: Conclave of Mages
description: Hidden school of magic that took in hunted spellcasters.

description_citations.text: "Third Path". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashnod survives the blast, changes her appearance and name, and by 80 AR founds the Conclave of Mages with Tawnos as Nod.
timeline.quote: she had founded a school of mages and artificers near Ronom Lake with Tawnos.

citation.text: "Ashnod", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Scattered Third Path mages seek refuge from the Church of Tal after the falls of Terisia City and Lat-Nam, finding it in the City of Shadows and the Conclave.
timeline.quote: the Third Path was left without a base of operations, its members scattered across Terisiare

citation.text: "Conclave of Mages", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nod and Duck found the Conclave on the ruins of the Monastery of Gix, and Jarsyl soon joins.
timeline.quote: The Conclave was a school that was founded between 69 and 80 AR by " Nod " and " Duck " to study both artifice and magic.

citation.text: "Conclave of Mages", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Third Path mages swell the Conclave, which is surrounded by the half-finished Maze of Ith under Lord Ith.
timeline.quote: Years later, the school was surrounded by the half-finished Maze of Ith

citation.text: "Conclave of Mages", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mairsil locks Ith in Barl's Cage and takes over leadership of the Conclave while draining Ith's magic.
timeline.quote: Ith's jailer Mairsil took over the role as the leader of the Conclave

citation.text: "Conclave of Mages", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Church of Tal army led by Primate Delphine attacks the citadel while Jodah and Sima free Lord Ith.
timeline.quote: Jodah and Sima freeing Lord Ith from his cage.

citation.text: "Conclave of Mages", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The enraged Ith kills Mairsil, turns Barl into a Rag Man, drives the mages away and razes the school.
timeline.quote: Mairsil was killed, Barl was turned into a Rag Man

citation.text: "Conclave of Mages", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tawnos and Ashnod found the Conclave of Mages near Ronom Lake.
timeline.quote: By 80 AR, he had reconnected with Ashnod

citation.text: "Tawnos", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Conclave falls to Lord Ith, surviving mages including Jodah and Shannan travel to the City of Shadows.
timeline.quote: making it the sole remaining school of magic on Terisiare

citation.text: "City of Shadows", section "Rivalry". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Persecution of wizards led to the creation of the City of Shadows and the Conclave of Mages, where they hid.
timeline.quote: Persecution of these magic-using wizards led to the creation of the fabled City of Shadows in the east and the Conclave of Mages in the west

citation.text: "The Dark", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah meets Sima; their ship is hit by a storm and Jodah is abducted by merfolk working for the Rag Man, who leads him to the Conclave of Mages.
timeline.quote: he falls overboard and is abducted by merfolk working for the Rag Man

citation.text: "The Gathering Dark", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah discovers Mairsil has usurped the Conclave from Lord Ith and keeps him caged to drain his powers.
timeline.quote: Mairsil has usurped control of the Conclave from its founder, Lord Ith

citation.text: "The Gathering Dark", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Inquisition led by Primata Delphine attacks the Conclave and the mages defeat them.
timeline.quote: they launch a huge attack on the Conclave

citation.text: "The Gathering Dark", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah and Sima free Ith, who kills Mairsil and then is restored by seeing his reflection in Jodah's mirror.
timeline.quote: The insane wizard kills Mairsil

citation.text: "The Gathering Dark", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Barl and Mairsil imprison Lord Ith in Barl's Cage for fifteen-odd years.
timeline.quote: Barl and Mairsil imprisoned Lord Ith , the founder, in Barl's Cage

citation.text: "Barl", section "Imprisoning Ith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Barl interviews Jodah, and Mairsil recognizes Jarsyl's name and assigns Jodah to the library.
timeline.quote: Mairsil told Barl that Jodah was to work in the library.

citation.text: "Barl", section "Meeting with Jodah". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Barl suspects Sima of being from the City of Shadows and reports to Mairsil.
timeline.quote: Barl suspected that she was from the City of Shadows

citation.text: "Barl", section "The duel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mairsil and Barl plot to make Jodah kill Sima in a proxy duel, and Barl prepares both mages.
timeline.quote: The idea was to get Jodah to kill Sima.

citation.text: "Barl", section "The duel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah and Sima duel and Jodah wins, and Mairsil goes to finish Sima.
timeline.quote: Three days later, Jodah and Sima clashed.

citation.text: "Barl", section "The duel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Church of Tal attacks the Conclave and Barl organizes the counter-attack, killing one of its members.
timeline.quote: Barl organized the counter-attack.

citation.text: "Barl", section "The attack". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Barl catches Jodah and Sima together, threatens them with his crossbow, and Sima unravels it with blue magic so Barl flees.
timeline.quote: Deprived of his weapon, Barl fled.

citation.text: "Barl", section "Barl's fate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah is traded to the Rag Man and taken to the Conclave of Mages, where he passes Mairsil's test.
timeline.quote: Jodah succeeded in the test that Mairsil , the ruler of the Conclave, had set for him

citation.text: "Jodah", section "The Gathering Dark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During a Church of Tal assault Jodah frees Ith, who rampages and kills Mairsil and the Rag Man, then is calmed by Jodah's mirror.
timeline.quote: Ith, who had been driven insane by his time over the Pit, go into a murderous rampage that resulted in the death of Mairsil and the Rag Man

citation.text: "Jodah", section "The Gathering Dark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ith tears apart the Conclave and the mages follow Jodah and Sima to the City of Shadows.
timeline.quote: the mages followed Jodah and Sima to the City of Shadows

citation.text: "Jodah", section "The Gathering Dark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Drafna founds the City of Shadows; Ashnod and Tawnos found a hidden school that becomes the Conclave of Mages.
timeline.quote: A hidden school of magic had been founded there by Ashnod and Tawnos in 80 AR

citation.text: "Third Path", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jarsyl leaves his grandmother and joins the Conclave of Mages as one of its first students.
timeline.quote: He left his grandmother Kayla and joined the Conclave of Mages

citation.text: "Jarsyl", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ith summons the Rag Man to find a rescuer, and it brings back Jodah.
timeline.quote: The Rag Man obliged and brought back Jodah to the Conclave of Mages

citation.text: "Barl's Cage", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah and Sima destroy the cage; Ith falls, rises again, and destroys the Conclave in rage.
timeline.quote: Jodah and Sima managed to destroy the cage together

citation.text: "Barl's Cage", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Delphine leads an assault on the Conclave of Mages and is killed by Mairsil with the Wand of Ith.
timeline.quote: Mairsil drained all of Delphine's magical defenses, and then stabbed her in the chest, killing her

citation.text: "Delphine", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Delphine raises an army of the Church of Tal and assaults the Conclave's citadel.
timeline.quote: After Primata Delphine raised an army of the Church of Tal against the Conclave of Mages , they assaulted the citadel.

citation.work: Fall of the Conclave of Mages
citation.text: "Fall of the Conclave of Mages", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mairsil drains Delphine's wards with the Wand of Ith, stabs her to death and burns her corpse.
timeline.quote: he drained her wards with the Wand of Ith and then stabbed her to death, setting fire to her corpse.

citation.work: Fall of the Conclave of Mages
citation.text: "Fall of the Conclave of Mages", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah and Sima free Ith by destroying Barl's Cage; Ith kills his Rag Man.
timeline.quote: Jodah and Sima had liberated Lord Ith by destroying Barl's Cage .

citation.work: Fall of the Conclave of Mages
citation.text: "Fall of the Conclave of Mages", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah redirects Ith's burning ray to set Mairsil on fire and restores Ith's sanity with the mirror.
timeline.quote: Jodah then used the mirror to restore Ith's sanity.

citation.work: Fall of the Conclave of Mages
citation.text: "Fall of the Conclave of Mages", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ith frightens the surviving mages away, crumbles the citadel and turns Barl into his new Rag Man.
timeline.quote: turning Barl into his new Rag Man

citation.work: Fall of the Conclave of Mages
citation.text: "Fall of the Conclave of Mages", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The surviving mages travel to the City of Shadows.
timeline.quote: the surviving mages of the Conclave all traveled to the City of Shadows

citation.work: Fall of the Conclave of Mages
citation.text: "Fall of the Conclave of Mages", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mairsil imprisons Ith in Barl's Cage for a dozen years, siphoning his mana while Ith slides into madness.
timeline.quote: Ith was imprisoned in Barl's Cage for a dozen years by Mairsil, the Pretender .

citation.text: "Ith", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah and Sima free Ith by destroying the cage.
timeline.quote: Jodah and Sima eventually freed Ith by destroying the cage.

citation.text: "Ith", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ith attacks the Conclave and kills Mairsil before Jodah restores his sanity with the mirror.
timeline.quote: An enraged Ith attacked the Conclave and killed Mairsil before Jodah used his mirror to restore his sanity.

citation.text: "Ith", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ith frightens the remaining mages away and destroys the whole school.
timeline.quote: Ith then caused the Fall of the Conclave of Mages , destroying the entire school before retreating to be by himself.

citation.text: "Ith", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ith causes the Fall of the Conclave of Mages.
timeline.quote: Ith then went on to cause the

citation.text: "Mairsil", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sima helps Jodah free Lord Ith at the Conclave of Mages, contributing to its fall; they go to the City of Shadows.
timeline.quote: where she helped Jodah free Lord Ith , thus contributing to the Fall of the Conclave of Mages

citation.text: "Sima", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
